record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.kind: OnMoveEffect (per-entity instance with a stack counter) read and reset by the SPIN_OUT ability
record.summary: PassiveEffects[Passive.ACCELERATION] is a factory that gives each Varoom / Revavroom its own AccelerationEffect (an OnMoveEffect). Every time the unit completes a pathfinding step (MovingState.move -> onMove) it requests +15 speed on itself (apBoost 0, no crit, not permanent) and increments an internal counter by one. The counter is incremented whether or not the speed actually rose (the speed clamps at 300). The SPIN_OUT ability (the units' skill, a separate record) finds this effect, requests -15 x counter speed on the caster and resets the counter to 0, which is the reason the identifier is also referenced elsewhere. Displacement through moveTo (abilities, knock-backs) does not call onMove and gives no stack.
triggers: Each step taken in MovingState.move's pathfinding branch calls onMove, which applies every OnMoveEffect of the unit
SPIN_OUT cast: reads and resets accelerationStacks (outside the passive file)

effects.declaredRaw: +15 speed per step, requested; counter +1 per step
effects.scaling: apBoost 0 and crit false with the caster being the unit itself, so no AP or crit factor. addSpeed first applies Big Eater Belt (+25% on the positive value, rounded down: 15 x 1.25 = 18.75 -> 18) and Twist Band (no effect on a positive value), then clamps speed to 0..300. A MELMETAL-passive receiver would convert it to attack, which does not apply to these units. permanent is false: the board pokemon is not changed.
effects.resolution: requested +15; applied = +15, or +18 with Big Eater Belt, limited by the cap of 300 (base speed 40, so 18 steps to reach the cap at +15 per step, fewer with Big Eater Belt). The stack counter is raised by 1 per step regardless of the applied amount.

effects.declaredRaw: accelerationStacks: +1 per onMove, reset to 0 by SPIN_OUT
effects.scaling: none; per-entity instance created by the factory
effects.resolution: SPIN_OUT requests -(stacks x 15) speed on the caster through the same addSpeed path (Big Eater Belt scales negative changes from the holder's own team; the caster is itself, so a Belt holder's reduction is multiplied by 1.25 with the 'down' rounding, whose direction for negatives was not traced; Twist Band does not flip it because the caster is on its own team), then sets the counter to 0. Because the counter counts steps rather than applied speed, the subtraction can exceed what was actually gained when the 300 cap clamped earlier gains, and it can differ again with Big Eater Belt (+18 per step gained against a -15 x stacks request, scaled by the same belt on the way down).

conditions: Only the pathfinding step of MovingState.move triggers it (the units are not DARK type, so the dark-jump branch does not apply to them)
moveTo / skydiveTo displacements, teleports and knock-backs do not trigger it (they do not call onMove)
One AccelerationEffect instance per unit, created by the factory when the passive is installed
record.resetBehaviour: The counter starts at 0 for each entity (a new instance per pokemon) and is reset to 0 only by SPIN_OUT. Speed gained is not removed by the passive itself. The effect lives in the entity's effectsSet for the fight; whether a new entity (new fight) starts clean follows from the constructor calling changePassive.
